mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a >0.5% FEDFUNDS increase, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a >0.5% UNRATE increase, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies adjust to lower sales expectations.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 3-month RSAFS decline, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a >2% INDPRO increase, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a simultaneous PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related industries benefit.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a 3-month HOUST increase, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower borrowing costs stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a FEDFUNDS decrease, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a simultaneous RSAFS increase and UNRATE decrease, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
